betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The exchange zone: repeatable counters that liquidate surpluses and restock shortages on cooldowns from one hour to one day. Every counter here is consumption-based — you hand in valuables, the book hands back goods. Nothing is given; everything is traded.

These counters are the bulk desk of the GTIT trade shop: the shop (tab MIAO Exchanges) handles retail rates all day, while these quests quote wholesale — higher thresholds, richer returns, and a cooldown between visits. Bring volume.

The door itself only asks that the EV milestone is behind you. Past this gate, the counters do the talking.
